customer: 561 Group public publishers and public service surfaces
outcome: Public 561 work can be discovered, entity-resolved, retrieved, cited, represented accurately, and measured across search and AI-mediated answer systems without using spam or synthetic visibility hacks.
responsibilities: maintain the public-property inventory and authority boundaries
define and verify the publication discovery contract
measure crawl, entity, content, evidence, distribution, retrieval, and measurement layers independently
import first-party Search Console and Bing Webmaster/AI Performance evidence when available
maintain representative human-language query sets by publication and topic
return concrete remediation work to the owning publication rather than merely generating reports
share proven discovery primitives across publications
feed validated methods downstream to Causeway commercialization
prohibitions: scaled pages created primarily to manipulate generative answers
fake mentions, link schemes, or invented third-party authority
special markup claimed to influence Google generative search without evidence
mutating personal or third-party properties without authority
confusing citation frequency with factual correctness or commercial value
